court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before A.P. Sahi, C.J. and Subramonium Prasad, J.)
respondents: Life Insurance Corporation of India, Rep. by the Chairman and Others .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. R. Singaravelan, Sr. Counsel for M/s. M. Srividhya
judgment_text:
Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issue of Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records on the file of the 2nd respondent in connection with the order passed by him in his Proc. Mktg./D1 dated 27.1.17 served on 31.1.17 and quash the same and direct the respondents to pay the salary withheld by the respondents from 6.2.15 with all monetary and service and with 18% interest.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

A.P. Sahi, C.J.:— Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner states that on account of the pendency of the writ petition, the relief, which otherwise is available to the petitioner, is being withheld. He, therefore, prays for withdrawal of the writ petition.

2. The Writ Petition is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, W.M.P. Nos. 3766 to 3768 of 2017 also stand dismissed.
